sharpest_needle: $7.6B claimed (2010-2015 tax and penalties net of credits, plus undisclosed interest) vs $6.3B reserved for all open years (UTB $4.4B plus $1.9B accrued interest and penalties): at least $1.3B unreserved. name: AbbVie
sharpest_needle: Since the Q2 2026 10-Q, AbbVie's Skyrizi royalty extends to combination pipeline assets, with payments now projected to 2044 (38% probability for the pipeline slice; Skyrizi itself ends in 2037). The royalty (roughly 16% to 21% of Skyrizi sales; cash paid $2.9B in 2025, $1.8B in H1 2026) bypasses adjusted EPS, gross margin and operating margin because it is booked as a contingent-consideration liability whose fair-value changes are added back. The cash size is not new: the CFO said "roughly $3.5 billion of SKYRIZI royalty payments" in 2026 free cash flow on the Q4 2025 call (ABBV 2025Q4 transcript; the verifier cannot attach the speaker to that line, so it is cited here in text, not as evidence). What is new and unsaid is the extension to combination assets and the adjusted-EPS bypass.
